towns.name: Candeth Keep
towns.summary: Candeth Keep (87.5S 67.1W, South Direlands) is the heavily fortified post-Throne-War town built by an alliance of Isparians, Tumeroks and Lugians, its name chosen from player submissions and its construction staged during the A Swelling Tide / Into the Darkness events. It is a perfect 192 m square of walls, halls, two- and three-storey stone towers and a stone gatehouse standing on a flat mesa (z 48) that is ringed on all four sides by a 48 m wide, 34 m deep moat ravine full of palms; the only way in is a land bridge to the gatehouse at the south-east corner. At its centre grows the great Tumerok tree (39.5 m) planted by Aun Utauri to symbolise the unity of the races, with a tree-house platform and the Ground Portal up in its branches, the Tree Portal (Town Founder quest) at its foot, the Life Stone beside it, glowing blue column-trees, three fountains and a well around the courtyard, and shops such as The Ravenous Mattekar Tavern, Lady Dain's Tower and the Healer's Home.
